relationships.subject: hydrogen sulfide
relationships.evidence_quote: H2S has a pronociceptive modulation on the Ca<sub>v</sub>3.2 subtype

relationships.subject: CSE
relationships.evidence_quote: primary afferent neurons, macrophage signaling by essential messengers produces endogenous H2S from cystathionine-β-synthase (CBS) and CSE enzymes

relationships.subject: Cav2.2
relationships.evidence_quote: participating in the release of nociceptive neurotransmitters such as glutamate, substance P, and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) into spinal interneurons

key_findings: Review: H2S effect on Cav3.2 is concentration-dependent, inhibitory at 10 uM and augmenting at 100 uM.
Direct modulation involves the His191 redox/Zn2+ site; CSE/H2S/Cav3.2 pathway proposed as a target for neuropathic pain.
